desc: Multiplayer > Camera, Fit everyone (the default), three players on one screen: in Rogueport's plaza (the open front, Mario put at 240 0 20) player 2 walks the partner left and player 3 their companion right while Mario stands; the camera pans toward the group and pulls back (at most a quarter) so all three stay in the picture.
